report:
Skin, left wrist, punch biopsy

Received in formalin is a punch biopsy of skin. Bisected and all embedded in 1 block.

(1) Punch, bisected, all embedded.

Sections show a piece of skin down to the subcutis. The epidermis shows compact orthokeratosis, wedge-shaped hypergranulosis, saw-tooth rete ridges and Civatte bodies. The papillary dermis shows a dense band-like infiltrate of lymphocytes, with pigment incontinence. The overall features are those of lichen planus. Please correlate with clinical findings.

SKIN, left wrist, punch biopsy - LICHEN PLANUS
